statutes.title: Rate of Tax - Taxable Years Beginning After 2022
statutes.breadcrumbs: W. Va. Code > Chapter 11 > Article 21 > Part I > § 11-21-4e
text_en: Imposes graduated individual income tax rates from 2.36% to top rate 5.12% enacted under HB 2526 in West Virginia.
text_es: Impone tasas de impuesto sobre ingresos individuales graduadas del 2.36% a tasa máxima de 5.12% bajo HB 2526 en West Virginia.
